key: SHELLY: Ready to battle?
en: SHELLY: Ready to battle?
ja: シェリー: バトルの準備はいい?

key: SHELLY: Perfect.
en: SHELLY: Perfect.
ja: シェリー: 完璧ね。

key: I have a pretty incredible Elite Four, so I rarely even get challengers.
en: I have a pretty incredible Elite Four, so I rarely even get challengers.
ja: うちの四天王はかなりすごいから、挑戦者すらほとんど来ないのよ。

key: And when I do, I have no trouble beating them.
en: And when I do, I have no trouble beating them.
ja: 来たとしても、負ける気がしないわ。

key: So let's go, \PN.
en: So let's go, \PN.
ja: だから、行くわよ、\PN。

key: Remind me what a REAL battle feels like!
en: Remind me what a REAL battle feels like!
ja: 本物のバトルってやつを、あたしに思い出させてよ!

key: Bravo! That was the best battle of my life!
en: Bravo! That was the best battle of my life!
ja: すごい! 今までで　いちばん　いい勝負だったよ!

key: SHELLY: 10 years of training and I'm still not quite on your level?
en: SHELLY: 10 years of training and I'm still not quite on your level?
ja: シェリー: 10年も鍛えたのに、まだあなたのレベルに届かないなんて?

key: Phenomenal, absolutely phenomenal...
en: Phenomenal, absolutely phenomenal...
ja: すごい、本当にすごいわ…

key: That was an incredibly fun battle.
en: That was an incredibly fun battle.
ja: ものすごく楽しいバトルだった。

key: I suppose now I should tell you about the last bit of my research--
en: I suppose now I should tell you about the last bit of my research--
ja: さて、そろそろ研究の最後の部分について話すべきね――

key: The Relic Stone is self-correcting.
en: The Relic Stone is self-correcting.
ja: 遺跡の石は自己修復するの。

key: It's tied close enough to Celebi that it's attuned to the timestream.
en: It's tied close enough to Celebi that it's attuned to the timestream.
ja: セレビィと深く結びついているから、時の流れに同調しているのよ。

key: So if I just give you this one to take back with you, that should all be fine--
en: So if I just give you this one to take back with you, that should all be fine--
ja: だから、これをそのまま持って帰ってもらえば大丈夫なはず――

key: It'll just get rid of the one in your time still stuck in the New World.
en: It'll just get rid of the one in your time still stuck in the New World.
ja: あなたたちの時代でニューワールドに取り残されてる方の石は、自然と消えるでしょうから。

key: Which... You're welcome, you not having to grab it yourself.
en: Which... You're welcome, you not having to grab it yourself.
ja: つまり…自分で取りに行かずに済むわけ。どういたしまして。

key: It was a real pain trying to figure out how to get it.
en: It was a real pain trying to figure out how to get it.
ja: 取り方を突き止めるの、本当に大変だったのよ。

key: How about I fly us all to Agate City, we can say "Hi" to a few people there, and then Celebi can take you two and the Relic Stone back to your time?
en: How about I fly us all to Agate City, we can say "Hi" to a few people there, and then Celebi can take you two and the Relic Stone back to your time?
ja: アゲトシティまでみんなを飛ばして、何人かに挨拶したら、セレビィにあなたたち二人と遺跡の石を時代に送ってもらう、っていうのはどう?

key: TAKA: That... sounds nice.
en: TAKA: That... sounds nice.
ja: タカ: それ…いいね。

key: And... thanks.
en: And... thanks.
ja: それと…ありがとう。

key: This has been a pretty weird day.
en: This has been a pretty weird day.
ja: 今日はかなり変な一日だった。

key: SHELLY: Don't mention it.
en: SHELLY: Don't mention it.
ja: シェリー: どういたしまして。

key: Just be extra nice to me 10 years ago when I'm still coming out of my shell, and we can call it even!
en: Just be extra nice to me 10 years ago when I'm still coming out of my shell, and we can call it even!
ja: 10年前のあたし、まだ殻を破ろうとしてる頃のあたしに、ちゃんと優しくしてくれたらそれでチャラよ!

key: Just talk to me when you're ready to go!
en: Just talk to me when you're ready to go!
ja: 準備ができたら声かけて!

key: SHELLY: Take your time to get ready.
en: SHELLY: Take your time to get ready.
ja: シェリー: ゆっくり準備して。

key: I don't want anything less than your best!
en: I don't want anything less than your best!
ja: 全力以外は求めてないんだから!

key: ELIAS: Seeing how people are doing here, in this future?
en: ELIAS: Seeing how people are doing here, in this future?
ja: イライアス: この未来で、みんながどうしているか見られるとは…

key: ...I would like that.
en: ...I would like that.
ja: …それは、ぜひ見てみたいです。

key: Thank you for your help, and being such a gracious host, Champion.
en: Thank you for your help, and being such a gracious host, Champion.
ja: お力添えと、心温まるおもてなしに感謝します、チャンピオン殿。

key: SHELLY: Time to leave, is it?
en: SHELLY: Time to leave, is it?
ja: シェリー: もう出発の時間かしら?

key: Everybody will be excited to see you both after so long!
en: Everybody will be excited to see you both after so long!
ja: みんな、久しぶりにあなたたち二人に会えて大喜びするはずよ!

key: I'll fly us there!
en: I'll fly us there!
ja: そこまで飛んでいくわよ!

key: SHELLY: We had a wonderful time in Agate.
en: SHELLY: We had a wonderful time in Agate.
ja: シェリー: アゲトでは素晴らしい時間を過ごせたわね。

key: Everyone was so excited to see you after 10 years!
en: Everyone was so excited to see you after 10 years!
ja: みんな、10年ぶりにあなたに会えて大喜びだった!

key: So many people have changed so much.
en: So many people have changed so much.
ja: 本当にたくさんの人が、大きく変わっていたわ。

key: And the look on El's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
en: And the look on El's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
ja: エルが、あたしの四天王が誰なのか知った時の顔ったら、最高だったわ!

key: And the look on Taka's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
en: And the look on Taka's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
ja: タカが、あたしの四天王が誰なのか知った時の顔ったら、最高だったわ!

key: ...But even the best days can't last forever.
en: ...But even the best days can't last forever.
ja: …でも、どんなにいい日でも、永遠には続かない。

key: I know you need to head back to your own time.
en: I know you need to head back to your own time.
ja: あなたたちが自分の時代に戻らなきゃいけないのは分かってる。

key: I'm sure you could spend forever in Agate, talking to everyone and seeing what they're doing now.
en: I'm sure you could spend forever in Agate, talking to everyone and seeing what they're doing now.
ja: アゲトでずっとみんなと話して、今の様子を見て回っていられそうなくらいだけど。

key: SHELLY: ...But don't you think that's a story for another time?
en: SHELLY: ...But don't you think that's a story for another time?
ja: シェリー: …でも、それはまた別の機会の話じゃない?

key: SHELLY: Oh, and \PN?
en: SHELLY: Oh, and \PN?
ja: シェリー: ああ、それと\PN?

key: Even if you'll be there to defend it in your timeline...
en: Even if you'll be there to defend it in your timeline...
ja: あなたの時代では、あなたがそれを守ることになるんだろうけど…

key: SHELLY: Watch your back-- I'm coming for your title!
en: SHELLY: Watch your back-- I'm coming for your title!
ja: シェリー: 気をつけなさいよ――あんたの称号、狙いに行くから!

key: CELEBI: Biiiiiii!!!!!
en: CELEBI: Biiiiiii!!!!!
ja: セレビィ: ビィィィィ!!!!!

key: Sensing the Relic Stone, Celebi rushed ahead.
en: Sensing the Relic Stone, Celebi rushed ahead.
ja: 遺跡の石を感じ取って、セレビィは先に駆け出した。

key: TAKA: This room has pretty unique decor...
en: TAKA: This room has pretty unique decor...
ja: タカ: この部屋、かなり個性的な内装だな…

key: Well, lead the way.
en: Well, lead the way.
ja: まあ、案内してくれ。

key: We have a Champion to meet.
en: We have a Champion to meet.
ja: チャンピオンに会いに行かないと。

key: ELIAS: The decoration of this room...
en: ELIAS: The decoration of this room...
ja: イライアス: この部屋の装飾は…

key: Oh dear.
en: Oh dear.
ja: ああ、これは…

key: I think I'll stay behind you while we meet the Champion.
en: I think I'll stay behind you while we meet the Champion.
ja: チャンピオンにお会いする間、私はあなたの後ろに控えていることにします。

key: Celebi is excitedly flying around the Relic Stone!
en: Celebi is excitedly flying around the Relic Stone!
ja: セレビィが遺跡の石の周りを、興奮した様子で飛び回っている!

key: Celebi is clapping after watching two Champions battle!
en: Celebi is clapping after watching two Champions battle!
ja: 二人のチャンピオンのバトルを見て、セレビィが拍手している!

key: CHAMPION: So, you've finally returned.
en: CHAMPION: So, you've finally returned.
ja: チャンピオン: ついに戻ってきたか。

key: Welcome back, Taka and \PN.
en: Welcome back, Taka and \PN.
ja: おかえり、タカと\PN。

key: Welcome back, Elias and \PN.
en: Welcome back, Elias and \PN.
ja: おかえり、イライアスと\PN。

key: CHAMPION: Do you like what I've done with the place?
en: CHAMPION: Do you like what I've done with the place?
ja: チャンピオン: この部屋、どう手を加えたか気に入った?

key: I took some cues from my old Gym.
en: I took some cues from my old Gym.
ja: 昔のジムから、少しヒントをもらったの。

key: CHAMPION: At first, people were at a loss of what to do without you.
en: CHAMPION: At first, people were at a loss of what to do without you.
ja: チャンピオン: 最初のうちは、みんなあなたたちがいなくてどうすればいいか分からなかったわ。

key: But sometimes people need to take charge of their own destiny.
en: But sometimes people need to take charge of their own destiny.
ja: でも、時には自分の運命は自分で切り開かないといけないものね。

key: CHAMPION: And it all turned out pretty well.
en: CHAMPION: And it all turned out pretty well.
ja: チャンピオン: それで、結局はうまくいったのよ。

key: Reborn is thriving.
en: Reborn is thriving.
ja: リボーンは繁栄している。

key: We've established connections with many other regions, and have grown into a global center for research and battle.
en: We've established connections with many other regions, and have grown into a global center for research and battle.
ja: 多くの他の地方とつながりを築いて、研究とバトルの世界的な中心地へと成長したの。

key: CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean you weren't missed.
en: CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean you weren't missed.
ja: チャンピオン: だからといって、あなたたちがいなくて寂しくなかったわけじゃないわ。

key: I may not have always shown it, but I enjoyed the time I spent with both of you.
en: I may not have always shown it, but I enjoyed the time I spent with both of you.
ja: いつも表に出していたわけじゃないけど、あなたたち二人と過ごした時間は楽しかった。

key: CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean your absence wasn't felt.
en: CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean your absence wasn't felt.
ja: チャンピオン: だからといって、あなたたちがいなくなったことを感じなかったわけじゃないわ。

key: Reborn lost two of its best trainers when you vanished.
en: Reborn lost two of its best trainers when you vanished.
ja: あなたたちが消えた時、リボーンは最高のトレーナーを二人失ったの。

key: CHAMPION: There I go, getting sentimental.
en: CHAMPION: There I go, getting sentimental.
ja: チャンピオン: あら、また感傷的になっちゃった。

key: Over the last ten years, I've learned to open up to all of my wonderful friends.
en: Over the last ten years, I've learned to open up to all of my wonderful friends.
ja: この10年で、素晴らしい友人たちに心を開くことを学んだの。

key: And I'm glad to see two more are back in my life.
en: And I'm glad to see two more are back in my life.
ja: そして、その二人がまた戻ってきてくれてうれしいわ。

key: CHAMPION: But of course, you're more than just trainers.
en: CHAMPION: But of course, you're more than just trainers.
ja: チャンピオン: でも、もちろん、あなたたちはただのトレーナーじゃない。

key: You're people that have been missed.
en: You're people that have been missed.
ja: 会えなくて寂しかった、大切な人たちよ。

key: I wasn't always the best at expressing my emotions in the past, but...
en: I wasn't always the best at expressing my emotions in the past, but...
ja: 昔は感情を表に出すのがあまり得意じゃなかったけど…

key: I'm very happy to see you again, \PN.
en: I'm very happy to see you again, \PN.
ja: また会えて、本当にうれしいわ、\PN。

key: CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Taka. Hey!
en: CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Taka. Hey!
ja: チャンピオン シェリー: \PN、タカ。やあ!

key: So, what do you think? Too much?
en: So, what do you think? Too much?
ja: それで、どう思う? やりすぎかな?

key: I mean, I love being surrounded by trees, and Tania got me really into fairytales these last ten years...
en: I mean, I love being surrounded by trees, and Tania got me really into fairytales these last ten years...
ja: だって、木々に囲まれるのが好きだし、この10年でターニャのおかげでおとぎ話にすっかりハマっちゃって…

key: So it seemed just right!
en: So it seemed just right!
ja: だから、ちょうどいいと思ったの!

key: TAKA: Wait, Shelly?
en: TAKA: Wait, Shelly?
ja: タカ: え、シェリー?

key: You're...
en: You're...
ja: 君が…

key: Not exactly who I expected.
en: Not exactly who I expected.
ja: 予想してた人と、ちょっと違ったな。

key: But uh... Hey yourself.
en: But uh... Hey yourself.
ja: でも、えっと…やあ。

key: I like it; this place looks nice.
en: I like it; this place looks nice.
ja: いいと思うよ。ここ、すごくいい感じだ。

key: SHELLY: I'm glad you like it!
en: SHELLY: I'm glad you like it!
ja: シェリー: 気に入ってもらえてうれしい!

key: So, let's compare notes real quick.
en: So, let's compare notes real quick.
ja: じゃあ、ちょっと答え合わせしましょう。

key: You found Celebi, presumably injured in the creation of the New World.
en: You found Celebi, presumably injured in the creation of the New World.
ja: あなたはセレビィを見つけた、おそらくニューワールド創造の際に傷ついていたところを。

key: You attempted to nurse it back to health, but realized its injuries were too complex for normal medicine.
en: You attempted to nurse it back to health, but realized its injuries were too complex for normal medicine.
ja: 回復させようとしたけど、その傷は普通の医療では手に負えないと気づいた。

key: And then you proceeded to jump through time with Celebi, trying to find a solution.
en: And then you proceeded to jump through time with Celebi, trying to find a solution.
ja: それで、セレビィと一緒に時を渡って解決策を探し始めた。

key: And now you're here, no doubt because Celebi was drawn by the Relic Stone?
en: And now you're here, no doubt because Celebi was drawn by the Relic Stone?
ja: そして今ここにいるのは、間違いなくセレビィが遺跡の石に引き寄せられたから?

key: How'd I do, miss anything?
en: How'd I do, miss anything?
ja: どう、当たってた? 何か見落とした?

key: TAKA: That's... pretty spot on, actually.
en: TAKA: That's... pretty spot on, actually.
ja: タカ: それ…かなり当たってるよ、実は。

key: How'd you know all that?
en: How'd you know all that?
ja: どうしてそんなに詳しく分かるんだ?

key: SHELLY: Well, even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
en: SHELLY: Well, even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
ja: シェリー: まあ、チャンピオンになった後も、あぐらをかいてはいられなかったし。

key: Between improving infrastructure and making connections with other regions...
en: Between improving infrastructure and making connections with other regions...
ja: インフラを整備したり、他の地方とつながりを作ったりする合間に…

key: I've been studying!
en: I've been studying!
ja: ずっと勉強してたの!

key: Legendary Pokémon, in particular. Including Celebi.
en: Legendary Pokémon, in particular. Including Celebi.
ja: 特に伝説のポケモンについて。セレビィも含めてね。

key: And I just tried to predict how Celebi would behave.
en: And I just tried to predict how Celebi would behave.
ja: だから、セレビィがどう行動するか予測してみただけよ。

key: TAKA: That's... really cool.
en: TAKA: That's... really cool.
ja: タカ: それ…本当にすごいな。

key: So you're like, Reborn's Champion AND Professor?
en: So you're like, Reborn's Champion AND Professor?
ja: つまり、リボーンのチャンピオンと博士を兼任してるってこと?

key: SHELLY: Gosh, you flatter me!
en: SHELLY: Gosh, you flatter me!
ja: シェリー: もう、そんなに褒めないでよ!

key: But no, I'm not a Professor.
en: But no, I'm not a Professor.
ja: でも違う、博士じゃないの。

key: I won't have the official qualification until the end of the year.
en: I won't have the official qualification until the end of the year.
ja: 正式な資格を取れるのは年末になってからだから。

key: But enough about me, come over here!
en: But enough about me, come over here!
ja: でも、あたしの話はもういいでしょ、こっちに来て!

key: You'll want to see this!
en: You'll want to see this!
ja: これ、絶対見たいはずよ!

key: SHELLY: Ta~daa!
en: SHELLY: Ta~daa!
ja: シェリー: じゃじゃーん!

key: One Relic Stone, straight from the New World,
en: One Relic Stone, straight from the New World,
ja: 遺跡の石ひとつ、ニューワールドから直送、

key: And one happy healthy Celebi, fully recovered!
en: And one happy healthy Celebi, fully recovered!
ja: そして、すっかり元気で幸せなセレビィ、完全回復!

key: However, before you can all go back to your time, I'm afraid there is one slight problem with all this.
en: However, before you can all go back to your time, I'm afraid there is one slight problem with all this.
ja: でも、あなたたちが時代に戻る前に、ちょっとした問題がひとつあるの。

key: TAKA: Oh no... Did we mess up the timeline somehow?
en: TAKA: Oh no... Did we mess up the timeline somehow?
ja: タカ: まさか…俺たち、タイムラインを何かおかしくしちゃったのか?

key: SHELLY: Don't be silly!
en: SHELLY: Don't be silly!
ja: シェリー: バカ言わないで!

key: You've done a great job, I'm sure.
en: You've done a great job, I'm sure.
ja: きっと、よくやってくれたはずよ。

key: No, the problem is simple.
en: No, the problem is simple.
ja: 違う、問題は単純なの。

key: I never got to fight the previous Champion when I claimed my title.
en: I never got to fight the previous Champion when I claimed my title.
ja: あたし、称号を手に入れた時、前のチャンピオンと戦えなかったのよ。

key: Of course, we've battled before, and I lost.
en: Of course, we've battled before, and I lost.
ja: もちろん前に戦ったことはあって、その時は負けたけど。

key: But I'm a whole different trainer now.
en: But I'm a whole different trainer now.
ja: でも今のあたしは、全然違うトレーナーなの。

key: So let's see how that battle would've gone.
en: So let's see how that battle would've gone.
ja: だから、あの時のバトルがどうなってたか、見てみましょう。

key: Let me know when you're ready!
en: Let me know when you're ready!
ja: 準備ができたら教えて!

key: TAKA: Y'know, I'm kind of glad I'm not you.
en: TAKA: Y'know, I'm kind of glad I'm not you.
ja: タカ: なんかさ、俺、君じゃなくてよかったよ。

key: At least everyone isn't desperate to battle me.
en: At least everyone isn't desperate to battle me.
ja: 少なくとも、みんな俺と戦いたくて必死ってわけじゃないから。

key: Uh, good luck!
en: Uh, good luck!
ja: えっと、頑張って!

key: CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Elias. Hello!
en: CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Elias. Hello!
ja: チャンピオン シェリー: \PN、イライアス。こんにちは!

key: ELIAS: Oh my, you're the Bug Type Gym Leader, correct?
en: ELIAS: Oh my, you're the Bug Type Gym Leader, correct?
ja: イライアス: おや、あなたはむしタイプのジムリーダーでしたね?

key: Thank heavens it's you and not...
en: Thank heavens it's you and not...
ja: ああ、よかった、あなたで、他の…

key: I was concerned I was about to get stabbed.
en: I was concerned I was about to get stabbed.
ja: 刺されるのではないかと心配していました。

key: SHELLY: I mean, I AM still pretty steamed you used your nepotism powers to get the OTHER awkward Bug Type Trainer an Elite Four spot instead of me.
en: SHELLY: I mean, I AM still pretty steamed you used your nepotism powers to get the OTHER awkward Bug Type Trainer an Elite Four spot instead of me.
ja: シェリー: まあ、あなたが縁故の力を使って、あたしじゃなく、もう一人のぎこちないむしタイプ使いを四天王の席に据えたことには、まだかなり腹が立ってるけど。

key: So maybe you still are.
en: So maybe you still are.
ja: だから、まだ危ないかもしれないわよ。

key: ELIAS: I...
en: ELIAS: I...
ja: イライアス: 私は…

key: SHELLY: Kidding!
en: SHELLY: Kidding!
ja: シェリー: 冗談よ!

key: ELIAS: That was very impressive...
en: ELIAS: That was very impressive...
ja: イライアス: それは、とても見事でした…

key: I do believe you have covered everything.
en: I do believe you have covered everything.
ja: すべてを網羅されたように思います。

key: SHELLY: I'm happy to hear it.
en: SHELLY: I'm happy to hear it.
ja: シェリー: それを聞けてうれしいわ。

key: Even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
en: Even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
ja: チャンピオンになった後も、あぐらをかいてはいられなかったの。

key: ELIAS: I clearly underestimated you, Shelly.
en: ELIAS: I clearly underestimated you, Shelly.
ja: イライアス: 私はあなたを明らかに見くびっていましたね、シェリー。

key: I had believed that without my Lord's guidance, surely the region would fall into disarray once more.
en: I had believed that without my Lord's guidance, surely the region would fall into disarray once more.
ja: 我が主の導きがなければ、この地方はきっとまた混乱に陥るだろうと思っていました。

key: ...Father Taube had faith in the people of Reborn.
en: ...Father Taube had faith in the people of Reborn.
ja: …タウベ神父は、リボーンの人々を信じていました。

key: I clearly have yet to learn all I need to from him.
en: I clearly have yet to learn all I need to from him.
ja: 私はまだ、彼から学ぶべきことをすべて学び切れていないようです。

key: SHELLY: Taube, you say?
en: SHELLY: Taube, you say?
ja: シェリー: タウベ、って言った?

key: Gosh, did you meet him while traveling through time?
en: Gosh, did you meet him while traveling through time?
ja: うわ、時を渡ってる間に彼と会ったの?

key: How exciting! I would have loved the opportunity to learn from him.
en: How exciting! I would have loved the opportunity to learn from him.
ja: すごいじゃない! あたしも彼から学ぶ機会があったらよかったのに。

key: Forgive me, but how do you know who Taube is?
en: Forgive me, but how do you know who Taube is?
ja: 失礼ですが、あなたはどうしてタウベをご存知なのですか?

key: SHELLY: As I mentioned, I spent a lot of time researching Legendary Pokémon.
en: SHELLY: As I mentioned, I spent a lot of time researching Legendary Pokémon.
ja: シェリー: さっきも言った通り、伝説のポケモンの研究にたくさん時間をかけてきたの。

key: Taube Alcantara is probably one of the foremost scholars of Legendary Pokémon to have ever lived!
en: Taube Alcantara is probably one of the foremost scholars of Legendary Pokémon to have ever lived!
ja: タウベ・アルカンタラは、おそらく史上でも屈指の伝説のポケモン研究者よ!

key: It took a lot of work to find his writings, but they were a treasure trove of knowledge once I did!
en: It took a lot of work to find his writings, but they were a treasure trove of knowledge once I did!
ja: 彼の著作を見つけるのは大変だったけど、見つけたらもう知識の宝庫だったわ!

key: And not just for my research, either; there were manuscripts detailing previously unknown history of Reborn, as well as details of lost traditions.
en: And not just for my research, either; there were manuscripts detailing previously unknown history of Reborn, as well as details of lost traditions.
ja: しかも、あたしの研究のためだけじゃなくて、これまで知られていなかったリボーンの歴史や、失われた伝統についての詳細な原稿もあったの。

key: Finding something like that...
en: Finding something like that...
ja: そんなものを見つけてしまったら…

key: Well, as Champion, I had a responsibility to research further.
en: Well, as Champion, I had a responsibility to research further.
ja: まあ、チャンピオンとして、さらに研究する責任があると思ったのよ。

key: I've been doing my best to help the region reconnect with its history.
en: I've been doing my best to help the region reconnect with its history.
ja: この地方が自分の歴史とまたつながれるように、精一杯手を尽くしてきたわ。

key: ELIAS: That's...
en: ELIAS: That's...
ja: イライアス: それは…

key: SHELLY: Oh, but there I go again, on and on about my research.
en: SHELLY: Oh, but there I go again, on and on about my research.
ja: シェリー: あら、また研究の話ばっかりしちゃった。

key: Follow me; you'll both want to see this!
en: Follow me; you'll both want to see this!
ja: ついてきて、二人ともこれは絶対見たいはずよ!

key: ELIAS: This future is... wonderful.
en: ELIAS: This future is... wonderful.
ja: イライアス: この未来は…素晴らしいですね。

key: The Alcantara family line has ended, and I am solely responsible.
en: The Alcantara family line has ended, and I am solely responsible.
ja: アルカンタラの血筋は途絶えました。その責はすべて私にあります。

key: That is a burden I will never stop carrying.
en: That is a burden I will never stop carrying.
ja: それは、私が生涯背負い続ける重荷です。

key: And yet... the future is bright.
en: And yet... the future is bright.
ja: それでも…未来は明るい。

key: The Order's teachings live on.
en: The Order's teachings live on.
ja: 教団の教えは生き続けている。

key: The Champion of Reborn is teaching the people to remember and respect the old ways...
en: The Champion of Reborn is teaching the people to remember and respect the old ways...
ja: リボーンのチャンピオンが、人々に古きしきたりを思い出し、敬うことを教えてくれている…

key: Thank you for showing me this, my Lord.
en: Thank you for showing me this, my Lord.
ja: これを見せてくださって感謝します、我が主。

key: Truly; it means...
en: Truly; it means...
ja: 本当に、これは…

key: Thank you.
en: Thank you.
ja: 礼を言う

key: ELIAS: Such an accomplished Champion...
en: ELIAS: Such an accomplished Champion...
ja: イライアス: これほど立派なチャンピオンとは…

key: But you're missing one key accomplishment.
en: But you're missing one key accomplishment.
ja: しかし、ひとつ肝心な功績が欠けていますね。

key: SHELLY: Exactly.
en: SHELLY: Exactly.
ja: シェリー: その通り。

key: ELIAS: My Lord smiles on me today.
en: ELIAS: My Lord smiles on me today.
ja: イライアス: 我が主が今日、私に微笑んでくださっている。

key: For I suspect I am about to witness the greatest battle this region has ever seen.
en: For I suspect I am about to witness the greatest battle this region has ever seen.
ja: この地方史上最高のバトルを、これから目にすることになりそうですから。

key: TAKA: Even without you, things have turned out pretty great...
en: TAKA: Even without you, things have turned out pretty great...
ja: タカ: 君がいなくても、結構うまくいってたんだな…

key: I guess Reborn really is filled with great people.
en: I guess Reborn really is filled with great people.
ja: リボーンには本当にすごい人たちがたくさんいるんだな。

key: ELIAS: ...When we get back, I'm going to get in touch with the Fairy Leader.
en: ELIAS: ...When we get back, I'm going to get in touch with the Fairy Leader.
ja: イライアス: …戻ったら、フェアリーのリーダーに連絡を取ろうと思います。

key: I need to apologize for manipulating xem under the Grand Stairway.
en: I need to apologize for manipulating xem under the Grand Stairway.
ja: グランドステアウェイの下で、あの方を操ってしまったことを謝らなければ。

key: And... maybe there's value in talking to somebody else who remembers the old days of the region...
en: And... maybe there's value in talking to somebody else who remembers the old days of the region...
ja: それに…この地方の古き日々を覚えている、他の誰かと話すことにも意味があるかもしれません…

key: TAKA: Nearly home now.
en: TAKA: Nearly home now.
ja: タカ: もうすぐ家だ。

key: I wonder who'll be in Agate City?
en: I wonder who'll be in Agate City?
ja: アゲトシティには誰がいるかな?

key: I wonder if they missed me...
en: I wonder if they missed me...
ja: みんな、俺がいなくて寂しかったかな…

key: No, sorry,
en: No, sorry,
ja: いや、ごめん、

key: Taube wouldn't like me talking like that.
en: Taube wouldn't like me talking like that.
ja: タウベなら、俺がそんな風に言うのを喜ばないだろうな。

key: Neither would anyone we've met today, really.
en: Neither would anyone we've met today, really.
ja: というか、今日会った誰だって、そうだろうな。

key: So, um...
en: So, um...
ja: だから、えっと…

key: I hope they didn't miss us too much.
en: I hope they didn't miss us too much.
ja: みんなが、俺たちのことをあまり寂しがってなければいいけど。

key: ELIAS: 10 years is a rather long time.
en: ELIAS: 10 years is a rather long time.
ja: イライアス: 10年というのは、なかなか長い年月です。

key: I hope long enough that those with a frostier opinion of me have had time to... thaw.
en: I hope long enough that those with a frostier opinion of me have had time to... thaw.
ja: 私に冷ややかな思いを抱いていた人たちも、その…雪解けするだけの時間があったことを願います。

key: I don't wish for hostility towards me to dampen your enjoyment of the experience-- no matter how well earned that hostility may be.
en: I don't wish for hostility towards me to dampen your enjoyment of the experience-- no matter how well earned that hostility may be.
ja: 私への敵意のせいで、あなたのこの経験の楽しみが損なわれることは望みません――その敵意がどれほど正当なものであっても。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
